text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer Training Camp begins. It is a 
crucial camp to push her limits in 
preparation for her showdown with Narita 
Brian.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer hands over the meticulous 
analytical data they prepared to Biwa 
Hayahide. It is an extensive plan looking 
ahead from her next race all the way to 
the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Biwa Hayahide reviewed the data, she 
realized how much effort it had taken and 
felt deeply grateful to her Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To firmly solidify her "winning formula," 
her second "Summer Training Camp" has 
begun.
